mo-3QHj.title: Sign: white street sign, blue border
mo-3QHj.summary: White street signs with a blue border around Chinese and Portuguese text. They only exist in Macau.

mo-5pnX.title: Lamp post: grey, black painted bottom
mo-5pnX.summary: Round grey lamp posts with a black painted bottom. Hong Kong has similar posts, but without the black bottom.

differs.how: Hong Kong lamp posts have no black painted bottom

mo-Hhsi.title: Bridge: cuboid towers with arches
mo-Hhsi.summary: The Sai Van Bridge has square block-shaped towers with arch openings in them.

mo-HyRc.title: Landscape: hilly rural roads, lamp posts
mo-HyRc.summary: In the south: narrow roads winding up wooded hills, with lamp posts a common sight. Few language clues, so the washed-out old camera helps.

mo-Q02G.title: Coverage: part of China for streaks
mo-Q02G.summary: Macau is a Special Administrative Region of China, so for country streaks it counts as China. Expect Chinese answers to be accepted.

mo-Rskk.title: Google car: very washed-out old Gen 2
mo-Rskk.summary: Old Gen 2 camera: low quality, round blur above and below the camera, and washed-out, overexposed colours. Macau has some of the oldest, so colours look extra faded.

mo-UfMe.title: Guardrail: red
mo-UfMe.summary: Red guardrails on the Amizade Bridge.

mo-YpXQ.title: Language: Portuguese beside Chinese
mo-YpXQ.summary: Portuguese appears next to Chinese on storefronts and signs, a leftover from Macau's time as a Portuguese colony.

mo-aq1W.title: Landscape: casinos and gambling ads
mo-aq1W.summary: Lots of casinos with flashy, kitsch designs and gambling adverts. Because the old camera is so dated, many newer casinos show up still under construction.

mo-vB8M.title: Houses: dense flats, narrow grid streets
mo-vB8M.summary: In the north: tall dense apartment blocks along narrow gridded streets with cars parked on both sides.

mo-xDZU.title: Plate: black with white text
mo-xDZU.summary: Black licence plates with white text, either long or square.
